'''Riloh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He had a cousin who worked for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he along with [[Egara]] and [[Scorch (Human)|Scorch]] worked for [[Rogun Matt'rik]]. The trio were hired to search for [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] and [[Voidhound|Ace]] for stealing weapons. However, they never knew that Ace was the traitor and that the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] was searching for Skavak as well. The trio found the smuggler in the [[Dealer's Den]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but were convinced to back down and leave.
